Class DatabaseManager

java.lang.Object
techecommerce1.db.DatabaseManager
public class DatabaseManager extends Object
DatabaseManager — Singleton JDBC connection manager. Provides all SQL operations used by the GUI Frames: - LoginFrame → authenticateUser() - ProductListFrame → getProducts(), searchProducts(), deleteProduct(), addProduct() - ShoppingCartFrame → getCart(), addToCart(), removeFromCart(), updateCartQty(), clearCart(), getPromoCode(), placeOrder() - OrdersFrame → getOrders(), cancelOrder() - ReviewsFrame → getReviews(), addReview(), markHelpful() - ProfileFrame → getUserProfile(), updateProfile(), changePassword() - InventoryFrame → getInventory(), updateStock() - TrackShipmentFrame→ getShipmentsByCustomer(), getShipmentEvents() Setup: 1. Add mysql-connector-j-8.x.x.jar to your project classpath. 2. Change DB_URL / DB_USER / DB_PASS below to match your MySQL server. 3. Run techecommerce_schema.sql once in MySQL Workbench to create the DB.
